ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large, high-intensity white blob concentrated in the lower-lateral quadrant [X: 10-40%, Y: 60-90%]. Right lobe: Broad, high-intensity diagonal band extending from mid-base [X: 60%, Y: 50%] to upper-distal tip [X: 95%, Y: 20%]. Both lobes are bordered by low-intensity margins at the trailing edge and central peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 145 degrees; notch depth is less than 10% of the total vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing boundary. Right lobe posterior edge displays 10-12 high-amplitude jagged peaks; left lobe posterior edge displays lower-amplitude, more rounded wave-like peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a primary convex arc; distal tips exhibit a tight convex curvature before joining the anterior edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approx. 2-6 pixels in diameter) localized on the low-intensity distal tips and periodically along the serrated trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, low-intensity vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) detected on the right lobe, traversing the high-intensity diagonal band; secondary faint horizontal abrasions visible on the medial edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive parallel vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring patterns on the extreme far-right distal tip.
